title: M016-S03 Safe Operational Probe Record v1
description: Machine-readable schema for role-specific safe probe records issued by M016-txa3vu/S03. EXECUTED records carry read-only live (GET-only) or bounded isolated scratch-drill evidence with objective fields (exit code, sanitised digest, artifact reference + hash, scope, limitations, source identity, mutation audit, isolation invariant). NOT_PROVEN records are explicit, schema-valid fallback records that acknowledge a missed probe through attempted exit code, observed blocker code and reason. EXECUTED and NOT_PROVEN branches are mutually exclusive — forgeries (missing objective fields, PASS-like NOT_PROVEN, mutation verbs, malformed hashes/timestamps, launch GO injection) are rejected by required, pattern and enum constraints so the downstream S04 evidence canary and S05 seven-division replay cannot promote a partial claim into launch. Role and independence-group values are constrained to the frozen registries in scripts/lib/m016-s03-safe-probe-data.js; production/launch verdicts and methods outside the GET-only allowlist are rejected.

task.description: Originating task identifier. Constrained to T01..T06 of M016/S03 so downstream slices (S04, S05) can trace each record back to a task.

generated.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of record generation.

probe_id.description: Stable, unique-within-role kebab-case identifier of this probe. MUST start with the frozen M16-S03-PROBE prefix so the registry can trace mutations, scratch drills and role probes back to the slice.

role_class.description: Frozen taxonomy. division probes target the seven canonical divisions; infrastructure probes cover hermes/paperclip/secrets/cost/isolation invariants and scratch drills.

role.description: Frozen role identifier from the S03 registry (Div1..Div7 + nine infrastructure roles). Strings outside this enum are rejected so the schema cannot be tricked into accepting a forged role.

classification.description: Two mutually exclusive outcomes. EXECUTED carries objective execution evidence; NOT_PROVEN is the explicit fail-closed fallback that never promotes to launch. Used as the discriminator by the conditional allOf branches below.

independence_group.description: Identifier of the independence group the probe belongs to. Reuse across two EXECUTED records with different artifact_hash is rejected as fail-closed. Frozen kebab pattern; runtime contract enforces uniqueness within EXECUTED-set.

method.description: Bounded probe method. Either a GET-only HTTP method restricted to allowlisted /api paths or a scratch drill kind token (restore-drill / budget-stop-drill / failure-drill). Mutation verbs (POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE) and bare non-GET verbs are rejected at the schema layer.

command.description: Bounded, sanitised reproduction command. MUST stay in safe charset and MUST NOT contain mutation verbs, raw body fragments, raw result_json.result fragments or vendor-reuse strings. Curly braces, equals, question marks, ampersands and percent are allowed so URL templates (e.g. {companyId}) and query-string style commands are accepted.

started_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of probe start.

finished_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of probe end. MUST be >= started_at (semantic check is enforced at runtime contract; the schema only constrains the format).

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock duration of the probe in milliseconds. MUST be non-negative; bounded at 600000 ms (10 minutes) so a runaway probe cannot stretch the evidence pack.

scope.description: What the probe covered. Sanitised plain text in safe charset; bounded to 200 chars to keep diagnostics compact.

limitations.description: Explicit limitations of the probe. MUST contain at least one entry so the schema cannot mask a partial execution with an empty limitations list. Each entry is sanitised plain text; bounded length. Items MUST NOT carry credential/token leaks (sk-/tp-/bearer) so the limitation list cannot smuggle the very data the probe redacted.

source_identity.description: Identity under which the probe was executed. oneOf restricts the shape per kind so a paperclip live probe cannot accidentally wear scratch-drill clothing or vice versa.

company_kind.description: For paperclip_api_readonly: which company was probed. Bounded to safe charset; forbidden stale UUIDs are enforced at runtime contract.

auth_method.description: For paperclip_api_readonly: auth method observed. Bounded to safe charset; full credentials never allowed.

scratch_root.description: For scratch_drill: absolute filesystem path of the scratch root. MUST live under /tmp, /private/tmp or /var/folders so containment is fail-closed; runtime contract additionally validates realpath.

drill_kind.description: For scratch_drill: which scratch drill was run.

bundle_ref.description: For offline_bundle_read: bounded relative path to the upstream bundle under runtime-evidence/.

oneOf.description: Paperclip live read-only probes carry company/auth metadata.
Scratch drills live inside an owned scratch root and declare their drill kind.
Offline bundle reads cite the bounded runtime-evidence path.
Observed probes have no further identity beyond the kind tag.

isolation_invariant.description: Recorded invariant posture for the probe. read_only_boundary_pass MUST be true for any live probe and any scratch drill that ran without escaping containment; false with a non-null boundary_blocker_code is the documented fail-closed condition for the slice.

boundary_blocker_code.description: Stamped when read_only_boundary_pass is false; null on a clean probe.

mutation_audit.description: Counters describing what changed during the probe. Live read-only probes MUST keep all counters at zero; scratch drills that legitimately touched scratch files still MUST NOT bump business counters (issues/documents/projects/goals/plugins/agents). Schema accepts any non-negative integer; runtime contract refuses anything > 0 for live probes.

redaction.description: Bounded redaction posture. Every leak-class flag MUST be false; bounded_digests_only and redaction_bounds_loaded MUST be true. Const values match the S02 sidecar redaction posture so the bundle and probe records stay consistent.

verdict.description: Bounded verdict vocabulary. EXECUTED records may emit 'pass' or 'fail_closed'; NOT_PROVEN records MUST emit 'not_proven'. Production/launch verdicts (GO, PASS_AUTOMATIC, READY) are forbidden at this layer — only the S04/S05 launch verdict dimensions can carry them.

blocker_codes.description: Stable M16-S03-PROBE-* blocker codes emitted by the probe contract. Empty array on a clean EXECUTED (verdict=pass); non-empty array on NOT_PROVEN or EXECUTED+verdict=fail_closed. Pattern enforces bounded stable codes so downstream S04/S05 can grep and alert on known failure modes.

exit_code.description: Process exit code observed on the probe. 0 indicates success and gates 'pass'; non-zero values gate 'fail_closed'. Mutually exclusive with attempted_exit_code (NOT_PROVEN branch uses attempted_exit_code instead).

sanitised_digest.description: Bounded, redacted digest of the execution output. MUST stay in safe charset; bounded to 256 chars; only present on EXECUTED records.

artifact_reference.description: Bounded relative path to the artifact the digest was derived from. MUST be inside runtime-evidence/ or scripts/. Only present on EXECUTED records. Path segments MUST NOT contain '..' so the schema cannot be tricked into accepting a traversal attack.

artifact_hash.description: Hex-encoded hash of the artifact contents (sha256 = 64 lowercase hex chars; sha512 = 128 lowercase hex chars). Only present on EXECUTED records.

attempted_exit_code.description: Process or HTTP exit code observed when the probe gave up. -1 indicates an unrecoverable runner fault; values up to 599 cover the full HTTP status-code range (incl. server 5xx and experimental 6xx). Only present on NOT_PROVEN records.

observed_blocker_code.description: Stable M16-S03-PROBE-* code from the frozen registry describing why the probe fell back to NOT_PROVEN. Only present on NOT_PROVEN records.

observed_blocker_reason.description: Sanitised, bounded reason string. MUST stay in safe charset; raw UUIDs and credentials are forbidden so the diagnostic never leaks the very data the probe tried to redact. Only present on NOT_PROVEN records.

allOf.description: EXECUTED branch — objective execution evidence (required) and prohibition of NOT_PROVEN-only fields.

verdict.description: EXECUTED verdict vocabulary. Mutually exclusive with NOT_PROVEN verdict const 'not_proven'.

not.description: EXECUTED records MUST NOT carry any NOT_PROVEN-only field.

allOf.description: NOT_PROVEN branch — explicit fall-back (required) and prohibition of EXECUTED-only fields.

verdict.description: NOT_PROVEN verdict vocabulary is frozen to one value so the schema cannot be tricked into admitting a PASS-like NOT_PROVEN.

not.description: NOT_PROVEN records MUST NOT carry any EXECUTED-only field.

allOf.description: EXECUTED records in failure mode (verdict=fail_closed) MUST emit at least one blocker code so the failure is auditable.
NOT_PROVEN records MUST emit at least one blocker code (the observed one).
Live paperclip_api_readonly probes MUST report scratch_target_used=false and read_only_boundary_pass=true so the schema cannot smuggle a drill under a live classification.
Scratch drills MUST report scratch_target_used=true and read_only_boundary_pass=true so a containment escape cannot pass the schema.
